_doc: When each public event was first added (America/Vancouver date; added_at = exact UTC time, from 4 Oct 2026) and last meaningfully changed (changed_at: title, title_fr, start or end changed between builds). Seeded 1 Oct 2026 from campaign_events.created_at; after that build.py (events_cal.py) adds any event id it has not seen, with the build time, and keeps title/start/end as an offline fallback. An event is 'new' for 48 hours (site.json events_new_hours) from the later of added_at (else 00:00 Pacific on the added date) and changed_at. Commit this file after a build that adds or changes an id. See README 'New events'.
